description: dispatch --dry-run prints the full card for a configured Explorer chain and creates nothing: no task directory, no routing.log, no herdr call at all (spec-tests-harness.md calls this the single most important dispatch contract). Task id is content-hashed from the (project path, role, task text, UTC date) tuple, so normalize.py's <ID> placeholder stands in for it.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.explorer-seat]
kind = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:test"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["explorer-seat"]

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"

stdout_contains: DRY RUN — nothing was created. No pane, no agent, no files, no log entry.
WOULD LOG  (not written — routing.log is untouched on a dry run)
event=dispatch	task=<ID>	project=sandbox	role=explorer	account=explorer-seat	pool=codex:test	outcome=chain-primary
WOULD CREATE  (paths only — nothing was written)
Every value is resolved. This card is dispatchable.
